CERTIFICATE OF REGISTRATION

Artificial Intelligence Management System

This is to certify that the organisation operates an Artificial Intelligence
Management System assessed against the requirements of ISO/IEC 42001:2023.

Scope: Governance, risk management, and lifecycle controls for the design,
development, and deployment of artificial intelligence systems.

Certificate Number: AIMS-4200117
Original Certification Date: February 1, 2026
This certificate is valid until January 31, 2029, subject to annual
surveillance audits.
